task.prompt: Create a polished, self-contained index.html for Northstar, an incident-operations console. Include a compact product header; page title 'Incident console'; an 'Active incidents' summary; a visually dominant incident named 'API latency' with severity, elapsed time, services, owner state, and an 'Assign owner' action; smaller secondary incidents; service-health indicators; and 'Recent activity'. Make the hierarchy calm and operational rather than decorative. It must work at 1440x1000 and 390x844, use semantic HTML, labels and visible focus styles, avoid horizontal overflow, use no external assets or network requests, and define a small CSS custom-property token scale for colors, spacing, and radii. Return only the complete HTML document.
